profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.description: Create profiles for separate renderer settings and libraries. Some desktop vault files and shared caches remain machine-level.

security.title: Secure by Default
security.description: Passwords and secrets are encrypted via OS native keychain (macOS) or Credential Manager (Windows). Never stored in plaintext.

safety.title: Family Safe Mode
safety.description: A master password is required before Family Safe Mode can be turned on or off. Family Safe Mode also forces provider safe_mode where supported.
